title: La Vendimia de Ensenada, VISTA STORIES
comment: vendimia-ensenada (VISTA): viñedo de una hacienda vinícola en el Valle de Guadalupe, Ensenada, Baja California. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.SILVESTRE_LARREA: Mexican man, proud owner of a wine estate, 66 years old, tanned light skin, thick white hair combed back, a trimmed white beard, a cream linen shirt under a dark-green quilted vest, khaki trousers, brown leather boots, a panama hat, his hands empty.
chars.FERNANDA_LARREA: Mexican woman, his daughter who runs the vineyards, 34 years old, light-brown skin, dark-brown hair in a loose low bun with a few strands falling, strong determined eyes, small gold earrings, a rust-colored long-sleeve work shirt with rolled cuffs, dark jeans, brown work boots, leather gloves tucked in her back pocket, her hands empty.
chars.LUCA_FERRANTE: Italian man, wine businessman, 40 years old, olive skin, wavy dark hair with a bit of grey at the temples, a short neat beard, a light-grey linen suit with a white open-collar shirt, brown leather loafers, dark sunglasses, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_VINEDOENSENADA: Vineyard of a wine estate in the Valle de Guadalupe, Ensenada, Baja California, in the golden late afternoon: long rows of green grapevines heavy with dark grapes on dry pale earth, wooden harvest crates stacked at the end of a row, a stone winery building with a terracotta roof in the background, dry golden hills, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
